```
module auth.passwords
  purpose: Classify how strong a password is.

public type Strength is one of
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify_password(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Rate a password as Strong (12 or more characters with letters, digits and other characters), Fair (8 or more characters) or Weak.
  tags: security, passwords

  example: classify_password("abcdefg1") is Fair
  example: classify_password("abcdefghijkl1") is Fair
  example: classify_password("Tr0ub4dor&3x") is Strong

  let has_digit be for each character in password.characters() any character.matches(raw "^[0-9]$")
  let has_other be for each character in password.characters() any character.matches(raw "^[^A-Za-z0-9]$")

    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
```

```
module auth.passwords
  purpose: Classify passwords as Weak, Fair or Strong.

public type Strength is one of
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

function is_digit(character: Text) returns Boolean
  purpose: Tell whether a one-character text is a decimal digit.
  example: is_digit("7") is true
  example: is_digit("a") is false

  return "0123456789".contains(character)
end

function is_letter(character: Text) returns Boolean
  purpose: Tell whether a one-character text is a letter, since only letters change under case conversion.
  example: is_letter("a") is true
  example: is_letter("Q") is true
  example: is_letter("5") is false
  example: is_letter("!") is false

  return character.to_lower() is not character.to_upper()
end

function is_other(character: Text) returns Boolean
  purpose: Tell whether a one-character text is neither a letter nor a digit.
  example: is_other("!") is true
  example: is_other("a") is false
  example: is_other("3") is false

  return not is_letter(character) and not is_digit(character)
end

public function classify_password(password: Text) returns Strength
  purpose: Rate a password: Strong needs 12 or more characters with letters, digits and other characters; Fair needs 8 or more; anything else is Weak.
  tags: security, passwords
  example: classify_password("Abcdef123!xyz") is Strong
  example: classify_password("abcdefghijkl") is Fair
  example: classify_password("abcd1234") is Fair
  example: classify_password("abc123") is Weak
  example: classify_password("") is Weak

  let size be password.length()
  let has_letter be for each character in password.characters() any is_letter(character)
  let has_digit be for each character in password.characters() any is_digit(character)
  let has_other be for each character in password.characters() any is_other(character)
  if size is at least 12 and has_letter and has_digit and has_other then
    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end

test "a long mixed password is strong"
  check classify_password("Abcdef123!xyz") is Strong
end

test "a long password without digits is only fair"
  check classify_password("Abcdefgh!xyzw") is Fair
end

test "a short password is weak"
  check classify_password("Ab1!") is Weak
end
```

```
module auth.passwords
  purpose: Classify how strong a password is.

public type Strength is one of
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
  purpose: The strength rating of a password.
end

public function classify_password(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Rate a password as Strong (12+ characters with letters, digits and other characters), Fair (8+ characters) or Weak.
  tags: security, passwords
  example: classify_password("abc") is Weak
  example: classify_password("abcdefgh") is Fair
  example: classify_password("abcdefghijkl") is Fair
  example: classify_password("correct-horse-7") is Strong
  example: classify_password("") is Weak

  let digits be "0123456789"
  let characters_list be password.characters()
  let size be password.length()
  let has_letter be for each character in characters_list any character.to_lower() is not character.to_upper()
  let has_digit be for each character in characters_list any digits.contains(character)
  let has_other be for each character in characters_list any character.to_lower() is character.to_upper() and not digits.contains(character)
  if size is at least 12 and has_letter and has_digit and has_other then
    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end
```

```
module security.passwords
  purpose: Classify how strong a password is.

public type Strength is one of
  purpose: How hard a password is to guess.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Rate a password as Strong (12 or more characters with letters, digits and other characters), Fair (8 or more characters) or Weak.
  tags: security, passwords
  example: classify("abc123") is Weak
  example: classify("abcdefgh") is Fair
  example: classify("abcdefghijkl1234") is Fair
  example: classify("Tr0ub4dor&3x") is Strong

  let size be password.length()
  let symbols be password.characters()
  let has_letter be for each symbol in symbols any is_letter(symbol)
  let has_digit be for each symbol in symbols any is_digit(symbol)
  let has_other be for each symbol in symbols any is_other(symbol)
  if size is at least 12 and has_letter and has_digit and has_other then
    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end

function is_letter(symbol: Text)
  returns Boolean
  purpose: Tell whether a single character is a letter.
  example: is_letter("a") is true
  example: is_letter("7") is false

  return symbol.matches(raw "^[A-Za-z]$")
end

function is_digit(symbol: Text)
  returns Boolean
  purpose: Tell whether a single character is a digit.
  example: is_digit("7") is true
  example: is_digit("a") is false

  return symbol.matches(raw "^[0-9]$")
end

function is_other(symbol: Text)
  returns Boolean
  purpose: Tell whether a single character is neither a letter nor a digit.
  example: is_other("&") is true
  example: is_other("a") is false

  return not is_letter(symbol) and not is_digit(symbol)
end
```
